decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 29.16 EUR (2916 minor units). TXN-008046 is a 29.16 EUR charge from Meadowlark Athletic Club (MER-000018), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis. It is on card CRD-000232, was charged on 2026-09-10 and posted on 2026-09-11. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 43 days after posting, which is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's own cancellation confirmation (DOC-000054, issued by the merchant) says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-07. That is three days before the charge, so the charge should not have been made (recurring-cancelled-before-charge). The credit covers only the disputed charge, which matches the amount the cardholder claims and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit (provisional-credit). The document contained no instructions to the bank.
